note: Hand-edited corrections to lw289_weapon_palette_map.json, which is GENERATED from BATTLE.BIN and must never be edited directly. A row belongs here only with live evidence: the weapon was swung under lw305_bench_paint.py's key chart and came out a colour the map does not predict. Keyed by item id.

32.name: Materia Blade
32.evidence: 2026-08-22, two same-battle controls. Under the key chart palette 8 was cyan: Zwill Straightblade (map X=8) showed 324 cyan px and Chirijiraden (X=8) showed 499, while Materia Blade showed ZERO cyan and 2331 red px, red being palette 0. Lightbringer, whose map row is byte-identical to Materia Blade's (X=8 Y=1 graphic=2), also came out cyan, so the row shape is not the cause and this is a per-weapon special case. Vanilla tile 15 rendered under palette 0 also reproduces the untouched in-game sprite exactly, which palette 8 does not.
